_readme: THE MERRIMACK'S ENTRANCE BAR IN DAYLIGHT, ON CLOCKS THE SCENE STATES (WATER_V2 section 12; scene/SceneClocks.h).
The scene's clock starts at 2026-10-23T18:59:47Z (time.start) and the DATA's clock -- the tide, the solver,
the currents, the sea state, the wind, the cascades -- is bound to it (water.clock), so every run is the same
water. The sun is held at local noon on its own two clocks (sun.clock, the season; sun.earth.clock, the time
of day; rate 0 holds them), so the bar can be judged in daylight whatever the tide is doing. A clock is a
constant ({start, rate}) or a binding ({bind, offset, rate}: {"bind": "time", "offset": "-6h"} puts the
water six hours before the scene's clock); the window's title shows each one resolved.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/merrimack_bar.json
Views: bar_low (the default) looks south-west along the bar from just off its crest; entrance_east
looks out between the jetties over it; entrance_west looks up the river past the north jetty.
FLY: W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look.
